options.text: Reuse of the same recently accessed data
options.why: Reusing the same recently accessed data is temporal locality. Accessing nearby addresses instead describes spatial locality.

options.text: Access to the next nearby array element for the first time
options.why: That describes spatial proximity, not reuse of the same recently accessed item.

options.text: Adding more virtual memory guarantees faster execution
options.why: Larger address ranges do not imply better locality.

options.text: A missing cache entry always means invalid memory
options.why: A miss can be serviced normally.

items.explanation: Reusing recent items is the time-reuse property, not a correctness or crash statement.
